chapters.title: Meet Otto
chapters.text: This is Otto. Every coding agent you run, in one native Mac app.

chapters.title: Home
chapters.text: Otto feels at home on macOS: a grouped sidebar, one clean header per page, and Home as your desktop, showing what needs you, what's running, and what's next.

chapters.title: The command bar
chapters.text: The floating bar is the front door. Press ⌘K, type or speak, and Otto runs the command, or answers in one of four spaces. It docks into the status bar while you work, and ⌥Space calls it from anywhere on your Mac, with the menu bar and pop-out windows close by.

chapters.title: Assistant
chapters.text: The Assistant is your personal agent. It keeps threads, remembers what matters, tracks tasks and reminders, and asks before anything leaves your Mac.

chapters.title: Agents and History
chapters.text: Agents run Claude Code, Codex or a shell as real sessions. Keep them in tabs, tile them side by side, or work through a queue of what needs you. Broadcast one prompt to many agents, and pick up any past conversation from History.

chapters.title: Run with Otto and Mission Control
chapters.text: Run with Otto turns a ticket or a message into a finished branch with one click, and Mission Control shows the whole work graph: what's running, what's waiting, approvals and spend.

chapters.title: Swarms and Goal Loops
chapters.text: Then automate. A swarm gives agents roles, an org chart and a shared board. Goal loops plan, execute and evaluate until every acceptance check passes.

chapters.title: Workflows and schedules
chapters.text: Workflows chain agents, approvals and tools into pipelines. Scheduled tasks run on a cadence, and personal agents keep their own soul, schedule and memory.

chapters.title: Git, reviews and proof
chapters.text: Git is built in: a commit graph with your work in progress, branches, pull requests, and multi-agent AI review with findings you can act on. Proof packs keep the evidence behind every change.

chapters.title: Product and Vault
chapters.text: Product turns stories into analysis and drafts, and the Vault keeps your docs as linked markdown with a live knowledge graph.

chapters.title: Design Hall and Skills Lab
chapters.text: Design Hall brings every studio under one roof: frames, templates, Site Studio, brand kits and 3D, with references to earlier work and a log of what Otto learned from your team. Skills Lab evaluates and sharpens your agent skills.

chapters.title: Database Explorer
chapters.text: Your infrastructure lives here too. The Database Explorer speaks MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis and ClickHouse. Build a query visually, with GROUP BY, HAVING and ORDER BY, then read the results in a grid, or one record at a time in the vertical view.

chapters.title: Connections and cloud
chapters.text: Connections hold SSH terminals and SFTP. Browse Kafka topics, AWS and Kubernetes, call APIs, read the web in the built-in browser, and govern every agent tool call through the MCP control plane.

chapters.title: Insights and Usage
chapters.text: Insights turns your activity into reports with key findings, and Usage tracks tokens, cost and machine load.

chapters.title: Everywhere
chapters.text: Snip anything on screen, bridge your agents to Slack and Telegram, and reach Otto from your phone. Otto. All your agents, one home.
